validLogin.rule: POST /auth with valid credentials returns 200 OK and a non-empty token string.

invalidCredentials.rule: POST /auth with invalid credentials returns 200 OK with body { reason: "Bad credentials" }.

success.rule: POST /booking with a valid, complete payload returns 200 OK and a numeric bookingid.

withoutAdditionalNeeds.rule: additionalneeds is optional; omitting it still returns 200 OK.

minimalPrice.rule: totalprice minimum valid value is 1; booking at that boundary is accepted.

maximalPrice.rule: totalprice maximum valid value is 100000; booking at that boundary is accepted.

sameDayCheckout.rule: A booking where checkin equals checkout (same-day checkout) is accepted.

longStay.rule: A long stay (≥ 90 days between checkin and checkout) is accepted.

depositNotPaid.rule: depositpaid: false is a valid state; booking is accepted.

missingRequiredField.rule: POST /booking with a missing required field returns 500 Internal Server Error.

invalidDataType.rule: POST /booking with coercible invalid types (string price, string deposit) returns 200; non-coercible types (number firstname, boolean lastname) return 500.

negativePrice.rule: POST /booking with a negative totalprice returns 500 Internal Server Error.

zeroPrice.rule: POST /booking with totalprice: 0 is accepted (promotional bookings).

invalidDateFormat.rule: POST /booking with a date not matching YYYY-MM-DD format returns 200 OK.

checkoutBeforeCheckin.rule: POST /booking with checkout before checkin returns 200 OK (date logic not validated).

emptyStringField.rule: POST /booking with an empty string for a required field returns 200 OK.

allIds.rule: GET /booking returns 200 OK with a non-empty array of { bookingid } objects.

filterByFirstname.rule: GET /booking?firstname={value} returns 200 OK and includes only matching bookings.

filterByLastname.rule: GET /booking?lastname={value} returns 200 OK and includes only matching bookings.

filterByFullName.rule: GET /booking?firstname=&lastname= combined filter returns 200 OK and includes only matching bookings.

filterByDateRange.rule: GET /booking?checkin=&checkout= returns 200 OK with an array response.

filterNoResults.rule: GET /booking with a non-existing name filter returns 200 OK with an empty array.

byExistingId.rule: GET /booking/{id} with an existing ID returns 200 OK with the full booking object.

byNonExistingId.rule: GET /booking/{id} with a non-existing ID returns 404 Not Found.

byInvalidId.rule: GET /booking/{id} with invalid ID formats returns 404; float IDs are truncated and may return 200 or 404.

success.rule: PUT /booking/{id} with a valid auth token and complete payload returns 200 OK with the updated booking.

unauthorized.rule: PUT /booking/{id} without a valid auth token returns 403 Forbidden.

nonExistingId.rule: PUT /booking/{nonExisting} with a valid auth token returns 405 Method Not Allowed.

singleField.rule: PATCH /booking/{id} with a single field and valid auth returns 200 OK; only the specified field changes.

partialDateUpdate.rule: PATCH /booking/{id} with only one date field corrupts the other date to "0NaN-aN-aN". Workaround: send both dates.

multipleFields.rule: PATCH /booking/{id} with multiple fields and valid auth returns 200 OK; all specified fields change, others are unchanged.

unauthorized.rule: PATCH /booking/{id} without a valid auth token returns 403 Forbidden.

nonExistingId.rule: PATCH /booking/{nonExisting} with a valid auth token returns 405 Method Not Allowed.

success.rule: DELETE /booking/{id} with a valid auth token returns 201 Created and the booking is no longer retrievable.

unauthorized.rule: DELETE /booking/{id} without a valid auth token returns 403 Forbidden.

nonExistingId.rule: DELETE /booking/{nonExisting} with a valid auth token returns 405 Method Not Allowed.
